DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆様で分ける大皿をご検討ですね。注文前に伺っておくことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're considering a large sharing platter. Is there anything we should ask before you order?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私には卵のアレルギーがあります。友人と同じ大皿から取るつもりでしたが、先に材料を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵のアレルギーがあり、友人と同じ大皿を食べる前に材料を確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. I was planning to take food from the same platter as my friends, but I'd like to ask about the ingredients first.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and that you want to check ingredients before sharing a platter with friends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 衣やたれも含めて調理担当に確認します。ご自身の分を別皿にすればよい、というご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the cooking staff, including the coating and sauce. Are you asking for your portion on a separate plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別皿にするだけで大丈夫とは思っていません。調理前から分けられるか、器具を共用するかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別皿だけでは十分と思わず、調理前の分け方と器具共用も確認したいと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't think a separate plate alone makes it all right. I'd also like to know whether it can be separated before cooking and whether utensils are shared.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a separate plate alone is insufficient and ask about separation before cooking and shared utensils. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理前の扱いと器具の状況を聞きますが、安全をお約束はできません。大皿の注文は先に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask about handling before cooking and the utensils, but we can't promise safety. Shall we place the platter order first?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の確認が終わるまでは、大皿も待ってください。友人には、私の分を先に取り分けないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の確認が終わるまで大皿注文も待ってほしいと頼み、友人に先の取分けをしないよう伝えると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please wait on the platter too until my checks are finished. I'll tell my friends not to set aside my portion first.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to hold the platter order until your checks are complete and explain that you will tell friends not to portion yours out in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の返答では、卵を含む衣を使うことは確認できました。別工程での対応はまだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The answer so far confirms that an egg-containing coating is used. We haven't confirmed whether separate preparation is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣に卵がある料理は私は頼みません。友人だけで注文するとしても、私が後で選ぶ物と同じ皿にはしないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵を使う衣の料理は頼まず、友人が注文しても自分の料理と同じ盛付けにしない希望を伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't order the dish with egg in its coating. Even if my friends order it for themselves, I don't want it plated together with whatever I choose later.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline the egg-coated dish and request that any dish your friends order not be plated with your own later choice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望は記録します。別の料理も調べられますが、材料や工程は改めて確認することになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record your request. We can investigate other dishes, but their ingredients and preparation need fresh checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別の候補は写真だけ控えます。今日は無理に注文を決めず、確認できないまま食べることは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別候補は写真だけ控え、今日は無理に決めず未確認のまま食べないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll just keep photos of other options. I don't want to force a decision today or eat something while the checks are incomplete.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep only photos of other options and explain that you will not force an order today or eat unconfirmed food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。お客様の料理は未注文として、大皿もいったん保留にします。確認できた内容は分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Your meal remains unordered, and we'll hold the platter for now too. We'll tell you separately what has been confirmed.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印をご希望ですか。お参りはもうお済みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a shrine seal? Have you already paid your respects?

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。御朱印帳も忘れたのですが、先にお参りしてから戻ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未参拝で御朱印帳もない状況を伝え、先に参拝するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I've also forgotten my seal book. Should I pay my respects first and then come back?
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not worshipped and have no seal book, and ask whether to worship first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。参拝後にこちらへお戻りください。今日は紙でお渡しする書き置きがあります。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please return here afterward. Today we have prewritten seals on sheets of paper.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書き置きをお願いしたいです。参拝する場所へは、この列に並ぶのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書き置きを希望し、目の前の列が参拝用か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like a prewritten one. Do I join this line to go to the worship area?
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a prewritten seal and check whether this line is for worship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列は授与所の受付待ちです。参拝の順路は、向こうの案内板に矢印で示しています。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-05.translation: This line is for the amulet counter. Arrows on the sign over there show the worship route.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列を間違えていました。戻ったとき、同行者の分も一緒に受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列の違いを理解し、同行者の分をまとめて受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was in the wrong line. When I return, can I receive one for my companion together with mine?
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different lines and ask to collect your companion's seal together with your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お申し込みの際に枚数を伺います。受取札をお渡ししますので、受け取る方がお持ちください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask the quantity when you apply. We'll give you a collection token, so the person collecting should keep it.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚申し込んで、私が札を持ちます。受け取りを待つ間、案内板を撮影してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚を自分が受け取ると伝え、待ち時間の案内板撮影について聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll request two and keep the token myself. While waiting to collect them, may I photograph the information board?
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will collect two and ask about photographing the board while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内板だけなら撮影できますが、受付の方やほかの参拝者が写らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may photograph just the board, but please don't include counter staff or other visitors.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人が写るようなら撮影は控えます。まず矢印の順路で参拝してから、二枚申し込みます。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人が写る場合は撮影せず、参拝後に二枚申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll avoid taking a photo if people would appear in it. First I'll follow the arrows to pay my respects, then request two seals.
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid photography if other people would appear and explain that you will worship before requesting two seals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お戻りになったら枚数をお伝えください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-OIT-USA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Tell us the quantity when you return. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の出庫表です。苗箱の準備をお願いしたいのですが、担当欄は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is today's dispatch sheet. I'd like you to prepare the seedling trays; can you read the assignment field?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の名前はありますが、空の箱を数える担当ですか、それとも苗の入った箱を運ぶ担当ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空箱の計数か苗入りの箱の運搬か、担当範囲を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is there, but am I responsible for counting empty trays or carrying trays with seedlings?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish counting empty trays from carrying seedling-filled trays when asking about your assignment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空箱の枚数確認だけです。苗の入った箱の運搬は別の担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Only checking the number of empty trays. Someone else will carry the trays with seedlings.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空箱だけですね。ただ、積んである箱に「返却待ち」の札が付いています。これを数えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空箱担当と理解した上で、返却待ちの札がある資材を数えてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just empty trays, then. But the stacked trays have a 'waiting for return' tag. May I count these?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the empty-tray assignment and ask whether to count materials tagged as awaiting return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その札なら出庫用とは分ける必要があります。出庫表には棚の番号もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That tag means they must be separated from those for dispatch. Does the dispatch sheet also give a shelf number?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚の番号は三番ですが、この札には二番とあります。別の山を探す前に、確認をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出庫表は三番、札は二番という不一致を伝えて照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The shelf number is three, but this tag says two. Could you check before I look for another stack?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the mismatch of shelf three on the dispatch sheet and two on the tag and ask for a comparison. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 照合しますので、その山には触らずお待ちください。数を記入する欄はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare them, so wait without touching that stack. Do you know which field to write the quantity in?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 枚数の欄はわかりますが、端の割れた箱も一枚として数えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入欄はわかるが、割れた箱を枚数に含めるか不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I know the quantity field, but should a tray with a cracked edge also count as one?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you know the entry field but do not know whether cracked trays count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 破損品の扱いは責任者に確認します。正常な箱と合わせて記入するのは、確認が済むまで待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check with the supervisor how to handle damaged items. Please wait before recording them together with undamaged trays.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、棚番号の違いと割れた箱の扱いを責任者に聞き、出庫分が確定してから数えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 棚番号と破損品の扱いを責任者に確認し、出庫分確定後に数えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll ask the supervisor about the shelf-number difference and cracked trays, and count after the dispatch trays have been identified.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check shelf numbers and damaged-tray handling with the supervisor and count once the dispatch trays are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二点を一緒に確認しましょう。出庫表はこちらで預かり、確認後に担当範囲をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check both points together. I'll keep the dispatch sheet here and explain your assignment after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの工芸案内をご覧になっていますね。展示を見るだけのコースと、制作体験があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at this craft guide. There is a course just for viewing the exhibition and a making activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 制作に興味がありますが、次の予定まで九十分しかありません。両方できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 次の予定まで九十分と伝え、展示と制作体験の両方が可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested in making something, but I only have ninety minutes until my next appointment. Can I do both?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State that you have ninety minutes and ask whether both exhibition and craft activity are possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内では体験が六十分、説明と片付けが合わせて二十分です。ここからの移動時間は別に必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The guide says the activity takes sixty minutes, with another twenty for explanation and cleanup combined. Travel time from here is additional.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それでは余裕がありませんね。展示だけなら途中で見学を切り上げられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体験には余裕がないと判断し、展示だけなら途中退出できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then there isn't much leeway. If I only visit the exhibition, can I finish viewing partway through and leave?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Judge that the activity leaves insufficient time and ask whether you can leave the exhibition partway through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示は自由見学と書かれています。ただ、展示室の一部は入れ替え中だというお知らせも届いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It says the exhibition is self-guided. But we've also received a notice that part of the gallery is being changed over.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見たかった染め物の展示が対象なら、別の予定にしたいです。どの部分が閉まっているか聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 染め物展示が閉鎖対象かによって予定を変えると伝え、確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the textile-dyeing display I wanted is affected, I'd prefer a different plan. Can you ask which section is closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your plans depend on whether the dyeing display is closed and request a check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示担当に問い合わせられます。染め物の展示が見られるかと、ほかに確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can ask the exhibition staff. Besides whether the dyeing display is open, is there anything else to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者は長く立てないので、展示を見ながら座れる場所があるかも尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者が長く立てないため、展示中に座れる場所の有無も尋ねてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion can't stand for long, so please also ask whether there are places to sit while viewing the exhibition.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about seating during the exhibition because your companion cannot stand for long. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。その二点の返答を待ちましょう。今は体験の予約を入れずにおきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's wait for answers to those two points. Shall we leave the activity unbooked for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 体験は申し込みません。展示内容と椅子の有無がわかってから、移動時間を含めて見学するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体験予約を見送り、展示内容と椅子の返答を得てから移動込みで判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't sign up for the activity. Once I know about the exhibits and seating, I'll decide whether to visit, including travel time.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Skip the activity booking and decide after answers on exhibits and chairs, allowing for travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では展示担当へ連絡します。返答をこちらでお待ちいただき、その後に行程を組みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll contact the exhibition staff. Please wait here for their reply, and we'll plan your route afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かき揚げをご覧になっていますが、お取りになる前に何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the mixed fritters. Do you have any questions before taking one?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびアレルギーがあります。この野菜かき揚げに、えびが入っているか調べていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: えびアレルギーを伝え、野菜かき揚げの材料確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a shrimp allergy. Could you check whether this vegetable fritter contains shrimp?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your shrimp allergy and request an ingredient check for the vegetable fritter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料表にはえびの記載がありません。ただ、それだけで混入がないとは言えないため、調理担当にも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shrimp isn't listed on the ingredient sheet. But that alone doesn't rule out cross-contact, so I'll ask the cooking staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料表にないことと、混入しないことは別なのですね。揚げ油をえびの天ぷらと共用しているかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 材料表示だけでは混入を否定できないと理解し、えび天との共用油を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So not being listed and not having cross-contact are different things. Please also ask whether the frying oil is shared with shrimp tempura.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that ingredient labels cannot rule out cross-contact and ask about shared oil with shrimp tempura. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、油は共用しているそうです。このかき揚げは安全に食べられるとお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked, and they say the oil is shared. We can't promise this fritter is safe for you to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かき揚げはやめます。うどんのつゆについては、えびを含む原料や調理器具の共用がわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かき揚げを見送り、うどんつゆの原料と器具共用の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll skip the fritter. For the udon broth, can you check ingredients containing shrimp and whether cooking utensils are shared?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline the fritter and request checks of udon-broth ingredients and shared utensils. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今ある資料ではつゆの原料を最後まで確認できず、器具の扱いも調理担当への追加確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The information we have doesn't let us check all the broth ingredients, and utensil handling needs further questions to the cooking staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できないまま食べるのは避けたいので、私の食事は注文しません。同行者の注文だけ別にお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認のため自分の食事は注文せず、同行者のみ別に注文できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to avoid eating before it is confirmed, so I won't order a meal for myself. Could you take just my companion's order separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline your own meal because checks are incomplete and ask to order separately for your companion only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、同行者のご注文だけ伺います。お客様ご自身の分はまだ何も注文を受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll take only your companion's order. We haven't accepted any order for you yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の分は注文なしで、同行者だけが食べます。確認できなかったつゆを、味見することもやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の注文がないことを確認し、未確認のつゆの味見も避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is no order for me; only my companion will eat. I won't even taste the broth that hasn't been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm no order for yourself and explain that you will avoid even tasting the unconfirmed broth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様の分はお受けせず、同行者の注文へ進みます。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't take an order for you and will proceed with your companion's. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お仕事探しのご相談ですね。求人を探す相談と、応募書類の相談では、どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about job seeking. Would you like help finding vacancies or help with application documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募先は決まっています。履歴書の職歴欄をうまく書けないので、書類の相談を予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募先は決まっており、職歴欄を書く相談の予約を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've already decided where to apply. I can't write the employment-history field of my résumé well, so I'd like to book a document consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your application destination is decided and request a consultation booking about writing employment history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職歴欄の相談ですね。書きかけの履歴書や、以前のお仕事の内容がわかるメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The employment-history field, then. Do you have a résumé in progress or notes describing your previous work?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 履歴書は持っていますが、前の会社で担当した仕事を日本語にできていません。母語のメモでも相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴書はあるが仕事の説明を訳せず、母語のメモで相談可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the résumé, but I haven't managed to put my duties at my previous company into Japanese. Can I consult using notes in my native language?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the résumé but cannot translate the job description and ask about notes in your native language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずメモの言語を教えてください。通訳などの支援を手配できるか、予約枠と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please tell me the language of the notes. We'll check whether interpreting support can be arranged along with available appointments.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。午前は仕事があるので、午後の相談とベトナム語の通訳を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモはベトナム語と伝え、午前勤務のため午後と通訳を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnamese. I work in the morning, so I'd like an afternoon consultation and a Vietnamese interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that the notes are Vietnamese and request an afternoon and interpreter because you work mornings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。通訳の都合でご希望に沿えない場合もあります。返答は電話と窓口での受け取りのどちらがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Interpreter availability may prevent us from meeting your request. Would you prefer the answer by phone or at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話では日時を聞き間違えそうです。窓口で返答を受け取り、日時を紙に書いていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話での日時の聞き違いを心配し、窓口で紙による返答を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm worried I'll mishear the date and time over the phone. I'd like to receive the answer at the counter and have the date and time written on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain concern about mishearing appointment details by phone and request an answer in writing at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、結果を窓口で受け取る希望として申し込みを預かります。現時点では日時も通訳も確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll take your request with the preference to collect the result here. Neither the date and time nor the interpreter is confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は申し込みだけですね。次に窓口へ来たとき、日時と通訳の有無を確認し、履歴書と仕事のメモを持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約は未確定の申し込みと理解し、次回は日時と通訳を確認して履歴書とメモを持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today is just the request, then. When I next come to the counter, I'll check the date and time and whether there is an interpreter, and bring my résumé and work notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Recognize the request is unconfirmed and explain that you will check the time and interpreter next visit and bring the résumé and notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。その二点をお尋ねください。申込内容の控えをお渡ししますので、お帰りの前にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please ask those two questions. Here's a copy of your request details; please look at it before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。書類を見比べていらっしゃいますが、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've finished paying. You're comparing documents; is there a problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場には健診を受けた日を知らせたいだけなのに、この職場の用紙には診断結果を書く欄もあって困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診日の報告だけを想定していたが職場用紙に診断欄があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to tell my workplace the date of my health check, but this workplace form has a field for diagnostic results too, which is troubling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected only to report the examination date but the workplace form has a diagnosis field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付だけの証明を求められているのか、この用紙全体が必要なのか、職場から説明はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your workplace explain whether they need proof of the date only or the entire form?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明は「受けたことがわかるもの」とだけでした。領収書には今日の日付がありますが、これで足りると判断できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場の説明が曖昧と伝え、日付入り領収書で足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only said something showing I had the checkup. The receipt has today's date, but can you tell whether that is enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the vague workplace instructions and ask whether the dated receipt suffices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは職場が受け取る書類を決められません。領収書には金額も載っていますが、その点も気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't decide which documents your workplace will accept. The receipt includes the amount too; does that concern you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。金額や結果まで職場に出す必要があるのか知りたいです。日付だけの書類を相談する窓口はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額や結果の提出要否を心配し、日付だけの書類の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to know whether I need to submit the amount or results as well. Where can I ask about a document showing only the date?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express concern about submitting amounts or results and ask where to discuss a date-only document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類担当の窓口へおつなぎできます。ただ、別の書類を発行できるかや費用は、そちらでの確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can connect you with the documents counter. But they will need to check whether another document can be issued and what it costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、発行を申し込む前に、日付だけの書類があるかと費用を担当の方に尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行申請前に日付のみの書類の有無と費用を担当へ尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then before applying for issuance, I'd like to ask the staff whether a date-only document exists and how much it costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about availability and cost of a date-only document before requesting issuance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご質問をお伝えします。職場の用紙の診断欄については、私が記入したり不要と判断したりすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on those questions. I can't fill in the diagnosis field on your workplace form or decide that it is unnecessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 診断欄は自分でも書き込まず、用紙と領収書は持ち帰ります。職場に必要な記載範囲を聞いてから、発行を申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診断欄を書き込まず用紙と領収書を保管し、職場に記載範囲を確認後に申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't fill in the diagnosis field myself either, and I'll take the form and receipt home. After asking my workplace which information is needed, I'll apply for issuance.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the diagnosis field blank, keep the form and receipt, and apply after checking the required scope with your workplace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず書類担当へご質問を引き継ぎます。職場への確認が済んだら、あらためてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First I'll pass your questions to the documents staff. Please consult again after checking with your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この机は引き出し付きです。天板の広さと収納のどちらを重視されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This desk has drawers. Which matters more to you: desktop space or storage?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: パソコンを置く天板の広さです。ただ、部屋のコンセントが机の後ろになるので、引き出しが邪魔をしないか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天板の広さを重視し、背面のコンセントと引き出しの干渉を心配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The desktop space for my computer. But the room's outlet will be behind the desk, so I'm concerned the drawers might get in the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Prioritize desktop space and express concern about drawers obstructing the rear outlet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引き出しの奥行きはこの図の部分です。コードを通す穴はありません。後ろの壁との間を空けられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This part of the diagram shows the drawer depth. There is no cable hole. Could you leave a gap behind it against the wall?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 壁から離すと椅子の後ろが狭くなります。引き出しのない型も並べて比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 壁から離すと椅子側が狭いため、引き出しのない型との比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Moving it away from the wall would leave less room behind my chair. Could I compare it alongside a model without drawers?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a wall gap reduces chair space and request comparison with a drawerless model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが引き出しのない型です。天板の幅は同じですが、奥行きが違います。椅子を引く場所も図に入れてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the model without drawers. The desktop width is the same, but the depth differs. Let's add room to pull out the chair to the diagram too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥行きの浅いほうを候補にします。部屋は三階でエレベーターがないのですが、箱のまま階段を通せるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 浅い型を候補にし、エレベーターのない三階への梱包状態での搬入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll consider the shallower one. My room is on the third floor with no elevator, so I'd also like to know whether the boxed desk can pass up the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider the shallower model and ask about bringing it boxed to a third floor without an elevator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包寸法はこちらです。階段の曲がり角などを確認して、配送担当が搬入を検討します。組み立てはご自身でされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the packed dimensions. The delivery staff will assess access after checking staircase corners and other points. Will you assemble it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で組み立てるのは難しいので、搬入と室内での組み立てを別々の項目で見積もってほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で組み立てられず、搬入と室内組立を分けた見積もりを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's difficult for me to assemble it myself, so I'd like an estimate listing carrying it inside and indoor assembly separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot assemble it yourself and request separate estimates for carrying it in and indoor assembly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配送担当にその希望を伝えます。階段の寸法がないため、今日は搬入の可否も合計額も確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell delivery staff your request. Without stair dimensions, we can't confirm either access or the total cost today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は購入せず、この梱包寸法の紙を持ち帰ります。椅子を引く幅と階段の曲がり角を測ってから、見積もりを頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を保留し、寸法表を持ち帰って椅子の幅と階段の曲がり角を測ってから見積もりを頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't buy it today. I'll take this packed-dimensions sheet home, measure chair pullout space and staircase corners, and then request an estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off buying, take the dimension sheet and request an estimate after measuring chair space and stair corners. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、候補の型に印を付けて寸法表をお渡しします。測った内容をお持ちになったら、配送担当に取り次ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll mark your candidate model and give you the dimension sheet. When you bring your measurements, I'll connect you with delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちですね。どの点について確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a notice. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週払ったはずなのに、今日また納付の案内が届きました。二重に払うことにならないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週の支払い後に通知が届き、二重納付を心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I paid last week, but another payment notice arrived today. I'm worried about paying twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a notice arrived after last week's payment and that you are worried about duplicate payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き違いか別の納付分か、まだ判断できません。お支払いの控えと通知を両方お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't yet tell whether the notice crossed with payment or concerns another payment. Do you have both proof of payment and the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 領収証と通知を持ってきました。金額は同じですが、どの番号を比べるのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収証と通知があり金額は同じだが比較する番号が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've brought the receipt and notice. The amount is the same, but I don't know which numbers to compare.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the receipt and notice with matching amounts but do not know which numbers to compare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 金額だけで同じ納付分とは決められません。通知に書かれた税目と対象期間も、領収証の記載と照合する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The amount alone doesn't establish that it is the same payment. We also need to compare the tax type and covered period on the notice with the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通知には税目がありますが、領収証の対象期間が読み取れません。記録を調べてもらえる担当へつないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知の税目はわかるが領収証の対象期間が読めず、記録を照合する担当への取り次ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see the tax type on the notice, but I can't read the covered period on the receipt. Please connect me with the staff who can check the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice's tax type is clear but the receipt period is unreadable, and request staff who can compare records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 納付の照会を扱う担当に取り次ぎます。ここではまだ記録を確認していないため、支払済みとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll connect you with payment inquiry staff. We haven't checked the records here yet, so I can't say it has been paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通知の期限が近いので、照会の返答を待つ間にどう対応すべきかも、その担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知期限が近いため、照会の返答を待つ間の対応も担当に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The notice's deadline is close, so I'd also like to ask those staff what I should do while waiting for the inquiry response.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to do pending the inquiry response because the notice deadline is near. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご質問も引き継ぎます。今の相談だけで期限が変わったことにはなりません。照会に使う書類はお手元にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that question on too. This consultation alone doesn't change the deadline. You still have the inquiry documents with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方とも手元にあります。納付の照合と、期限までの対応を担当に尋ねます。自分で通知を不要と決めず、書類を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両書類を保持し、照合と期限までの対応を尋ね、通知を自己判断で不要としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have both. I'll ask the staff about matching the payment and what to do before the deadline. I won't decide the notice is unnecessary myself; I'll keep the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep both documents, ask about matching and action before the deadline, and do not discard the notice based on your own judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの書類を持って、こちらで担当への取り次ぎをお待ちください。確認したい点も一緒にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-USA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait here with both documents while we connect you with the staff. I'll pass on your questions too.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その絵の前で解説を読んでいらっしゃいましたね。気になる言葉がありましたか。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were reading the explanation in front of that painting. Was there a word that caught your attention?

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 題名は「窓」とありますが、窓の形が見えません。私が見落としているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 「窓」という題名に対して窓の形が見えず、見落としているのか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-02.translation: The title says 'Window,' but I can't see a window shape. Am I overlooking it?
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you missed the window shape despite the title 'Window.' Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この解説には、形をそのまま描くのではなく、窓から感じた明るさを色で表した、とあります。どの部分が窓に見えませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-03.translation: The explanation says that instead of depicting the shape literally, the artist expressed the brightness felt from a window in color. Which part didn't look like a window to you?

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い線を窓枠だと思って探していました。形ではなく、明るさの印象を見るということですね。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い線を窓枠として探していたと説明し、形ではなく明るさの印象を見る読み方を確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was looking for the blue lines as a window frame. So I can look at the impression of brightness rather than the shape.
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you looked for a frame in the blue lines and confirm viewing the impression of brightness rather than form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その読み方もできます。感じ方を一つに決める必要はありません。解説にある「余白」という言葉も説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is one way to read it too. You don't have to settle on a single impression. Shall I also explain the word 'negative space' in the description?

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。何も描かれていない失敗の部分という意味ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解説の「余白」が何も描かれていない失敗の部分という意味なのか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Doesn't it mean a failed part where nothing has been painted?
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether negative space means an unsuccessful area left unpainted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 余白は、描き込まれていない空間を指す言葉です。この解説では、その空間と色の関係に注目しています。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Negative space refers to space that hasn't been filled in with painting. This explanation focuses on the relationship between that space and color.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その言葉をノートに書きたいです。解説の写真も撮ってよいですか。入口の表示を見逃してしまいました。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 余白という語をノートに書きたいと伝え、見逃した撮影表示について解説の撮影可否を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to write that word in my notebook. May I photograph the explanation too? I missed the sign at the entrance.
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to note the term and whether photographing the explanation is allowed because you missed the entrance sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この作品と解説の横には撮影不可の表示があります。写真は撮らず、ご自分の言葉で短くメモするのでしたら、通路を空けてお願いします。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a no-photography sign beside this work and explanation. Instead of photos, you may make brief notes in your own words; please keep the passage clear.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影はしません。横の空いている所で「余白は描き込まれていない空間」と書いてから、少し離れて絵を見直します。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影せず通路を空けて余白の意味をメモし、離れた位置から絵を見直すと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't take a photo. I'll write 'negative space is space not filled in with painting' in the open area to the side, then step back a little to look at the painting again.
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid photography, keep the passage clear while noting the term and view the painting again from farther away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、違う距離から見た印象も比べてみてください。作品には触れず、どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-OIT-YUFU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then try comparing your impressions from different distances too. Please don't touch the artwork, and take your time.
